## FieldsOf type

The fields of a provider's rows, raw and derived, as its declaration types them; a provider  named by its id has fields of any name.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FieldsOf<P> = P extends Provider<infer _Id, infer _N, infer R, infer D, infer _Meta> ? unknown extends R ? Attrs : Flat<Readonly<R> & {
    readonly [F in keyof D]: DerivedValue<D[F]>;
}> : Attrs;
```
